articles.summary: DigitalOcean is joining the Omacom Foundation, the nonprofit that funds Omarchy's infrastructure and the open source projects it depends on, as a Founding Corporate Patron, and will serve as Omarchy's agentic compute provider.
articles.title: Built for agents: Omarchy's pipeline moves to DigitalOcean

articles.summary: Founders should be free to build without tying their future to a single intelligence provider. Join us at the Open Intelligence Summit, October 12 and 13 in San Francisco.
articles.title: Intelligence is yours. Let's keep it that way.
